251	"And he said, Why, HaShem, does Your wrath burn against Your people, whom You brought out	"E disse: Por que, HaShem, se acende a Tua ira contra o Teu povo, que tiraste	
252	of the land of Egypt with great power and a mighty hand?" You told me, "Go down, for your people have corrupted themselves,	da terra do Egito com grande poder e mão forte?" Tu me disseste: "Desce, pois o teu povo se corrompeu,
